project_type: Next.js 16.3.3 App Router + Tailwind v4 dashboard app (client portal, coach portal, admin console)
build_system: Next.js CLI — `npm run build`. Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss (postcss.config.mjs). No tailwind.config.ts — all design tokens live in app/globals.css under @theme block and :root/:light CSS variables. NO hardcoded colors allowed — use semantic token classes only.
test_framework: None — no test runner installed. Verification is `npm run build` (exit 0) + `npm run lint`.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from c:\website\GrooveSystem. Exit code 0 = pass. Then `npm run lint`. Fix any TypeScript errors or ESLint errors before marking complete.
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell). All file paths must use forward slashes or be quoted properly. The workspace root is c:\website\GrooveSystem — all imports use @/ alias which maps to this root.
contribution_requirements: No new npm packages. No hardcoded hex values — use only existing CSS variable classes (bg-accent, text-muted-foreground, border-border, etc.). No changes to Supabase queries, server actions, modal logic, or route files. No changes to globals.css, navigation.ts files, or any UI primitives (Button, Card, Modal, Badge).
key_patterns: 1) Components are 'use client' when they use hooks/state. 2) Tailwind v4: utility classes map to CSS vars defined in @theme in globals.css. Available semantic classes: bg-background, bg-card, bg-muted, bg-accent, bg-accent-soft, bg-success-soft, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, text-accent-text, text-subtle-foreground, border-border, border-border-strong, border-accent-border, border-divider. 3) Base CSS classes: g-card (rounded-[20px] border bg-card), g-skeleton (shimmer animation), g-eyebrow (accent pill), g-header-* (nav chrome). 4) Shared components: StatCard (GlassCard wrapper), Card+CardHeader, EmptyState (compact prop), Badge (variant prop), Button (variant+size props), Modal (full focus trap). 5) Dashboard layout: max-w-[1240px] mx-auto, px-5 py-7 sm:px-8 sm:py-9. 6) Grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 for stat rows; lg:grid-cols-3 for main+sidebar layout.
directory_structure: app/(client)/client/home/page.tsx — client home page (use client, all state+fetching inline). app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx — coach home page (use client, all state+fetching inline, plus ProfileModal/TicketModal/MiniCalendar sub-components defined inline). components/shared/ — AppTopNav.tsx (primary nav, 3-zone header), DashboardLayout.tsx (shell), StatCard.tsx, GlassCard.tsx, EmptyState.tsx, SectionHeader.tsx (PageHeader export). components/ui/ — Card.tsx (CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter), Badge.tsx, Button.tsx, Modal.tsx, Skeleton.tsx. components/badges/ — BadgeCollection.tsx (complete, already built), BadgeCard.tsx, BadgeModal.tsx. components/dashboard/ — does NOT exist yet; all 7 widget files go here.
